title: US Schools Are Ditching Chromebooks for MacBooks by the Thousands— Apple Just Named Names

Apple's latest earnings call revealed a wave of K-12 districts abandoning Chromebooks and Windows machines in favor of the company's new MacBook Neo, with Chief Financial Officer Kevan Parekh naming specific schools driving the shift.

Districts Go All-In on MacBook Neo

Parekh told analysts on Thursday that in Florida, Pinellas County Schools — one of the state's largest districts — is moving 25,000 students from Windows devices to MacBook Neo across its 18 high schools.

In Washington state, Peninsula School District 401 has shifted more than 8,000 students off Chromebooks and onto the new MacBooks. In Oklahoma, Midwest City-Del City School District purchased over 6,000 MacBook Neos, becoming what Parekh called an "all-Apple district for students."

And, the pattern isn't isolated to a handful of districts. Parekh said that last quarter, roughly half of all MacBook Neo large-volume purchases by U.S. education institutions displaced Windows and Chromebook devices, causing a notable dent in a market Chromebooks have long dominated on price.

He added that many districts are leaning on Apple Financial Services to fund the rollouts at scale.

Mac Just Had Its Best June Quarter Ever

The education push is part of a broader Mac breakout. Apple reported Mac revenue of $10.4 billion, up 29% year-over-year, a new June quarter record, crediting strength in both MacBook Neo and MacBook Pro. Parekh said Mac posted its "best quarter ever for customers new to the Mac and for upgraders worldwide," including in the U.S., China Mainland, and India, with U.S. customer satisfaction at 95%.

MacBook Neo is also gaining ground with enterprise buyers, reaching users Parekh described as spanning "from bank branches to retail storefronts."

The entry-level 13-inch laptop starts at $699 ($599 for students) and runs on the A18 Pro chip — the same processor that debuted in the iPhone 16 Pro back in 2024.

苹果最新的财报电话会议显示，K-12 学区纷纷放弃 Chromebook 和 Windows 机器，转而使用该公司的新款 MacBook Neo，首席财务官 Kevan Parekh 点名了推动这一转变的具体学校。

各地区全力支持 MacBook Neo

Parekh 周四告诉分析师，在佛罗里达州，皮内拉斯县学校（该州最大的学区之一）正在将其 18 所高中的 25,000 名学生从 Windows 设备转移到 MacBook Neo。

在华盛顿州，半岛学区 401 已将 8,000 多名学生从 Chromebook 转向新的 MacBook。 在俄克拉荷马州，Midwest City-Del City 学区购买了 6,000 多台 MacBook Neo，成为 Parekh 所说的“全苹果学生学区”。

而且，这种模式并不局限于少数几个地区。 Parekh 表示，上个季度，美国教育机构大批量购买的 MacBook Neo 中约有一半取代了 Windows 和 Chromebook 设备，这对 Chromebook 长期以来在价格上占据主导地位的市场造成了显着影响。

他补充说，许多地区正在依靠苹果金融服务来为大规模推广提供资金。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

Mac 刚刚度过了有史以来最好的六月季度

教育推广是 Mac 更广泛突破的一部分。 苹果公布 Mac 营收为 104 亿美元，同比增长 29%，创下 6 月份季度新纪录，这归功于 MacBook Neo 和 MacBook Pro 的强劲表现。 帕里克表示，Mac 发布了“对于 Mac 新用户和全球升级者来说有史以来最好的季度”，其中包括美国、中国大陆和印度，其中美国客户满意度为 95%。

MacBook Neo 也赢得了企业买家的青睐，Parekh 描述的用户范围涵盖“从银行分行到零售店面”。

这款入门级 13 英寸笔记本电脑起价 699 美元（学生 599 美元），搭载 A18 Pro 芯片，该处理器与 2024 年 iPhone 16 Pro 中首次亮相的处理器相同。
